description: The pie chart represents the comparison of time costs before and after the implementation of efficient deployment methods. There are two slices in the chart. The first slice, labeled "Efficient deployment," is colored blue and accounts for 30.08% of the chart, corresponding to 26.2 seconds. The second slice, labeled "Reduction," is colored orange and represents 69.92% of the chart, corresponding to 60.9 seconds. The chart includes percentage labels inside the slices and does not have a legend. The slices are not visually emphasized in any particular way.
